hypothesis: Class-balanced patient support in the frozen MLP embedding may correct nonlinear local residuals beyond a shared-covariance prototype. Compare residual targets with a direct kernel classifier under the same supports, bandwidth and ridge.
support: One equally weighted mean per fitting patient/coarse-label pair, including mixed-label patients only within their own label. Three class masses each1/3.
kernel: RBF exp(-squared_distance/(2*bandwidth_multiplier*median_positive_fitting_pair_squared_distance)); median comes only from fitting support centers.
target_policy: Residual target is one_hot(label)-mean source MLP probability for that patient/label; direct target is one_hot(label). Source MLP unchanged and only fitting images supply targets.
solver: Minimize sum_s patient_class_weight_s*||kernel_function(center_s)-target_s||^2 + ridge*RKHS_norm_squared, with weights summing to1. Solve in a symmetric sqrt-weighted dual system in float64.
prediction: Residual: Euclidean simplex projection of source_probability + branch_weight*kernel_residual. Direct control: mix source_probability with simplex-projected kernel labels. No test/query graph fitting or transduction.
evaluation: Validation plus original3outer patient folds, each source/supported residual uses its own inner fitting rows; all configurations receive all folds.
selection: Higher originalCV than M5 and validation Macro-F1 no lower than M5; any eligible winner must then pass fixed new patient partitions before freeze or external scoring.
external_test_policy: Never load external predictions, outcomes or raw images; never use external results to choose any configuration.
